[USER] User needs new ideas for meal prep.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Quinoa and roasted veggies are a fantastic combo!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested protein sources that pair well with quinoa and roasted vegetables:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Grilled Chicken: Marinate chicken breast and grill.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Pan-Seared Salmon: Season with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Lentil or Mushroom Bolognese: Cook lentils or mushrooms with onions, garlic, and tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Roasted Turkey Breast: Season and roast turkey breast.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Tofu: Marinate and bake or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Shrimp: Sauté with garlic, lemon, and herbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Chickpeas: Add to quinoa and roasted veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Grilled Steak: Grill and slice to serve.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Edamame: Boil or steam and season.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Tempeh: Marinate and bake or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These protein sources offer a variety of flavors and textures.  
[USER] User has had grilled chicken and turkey breast before.  
[USER] User has never tried lentil or mushroom bolognese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a simple recipe for Lentil Bolognese:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients include 1 cup dried green or brown lentils, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups mixed mushrooms, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, 1 can crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt, pepper, and 1/4 cup red wine (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cooking instructions include sautéing aromatics, adding mushrooms, lentils, spices, tomatoes, and simmering.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for variations include using different lentil types, adding other aromatics, and making it a one-pot meal.  
[USER] User would like suggestions for sides or add-ins to go with lentil bolognese and quinoa.
